global_approval_definition: ChEMBL molecule max_phase == 4; collapse to parent molecule; exclude families with only withdrawn approved records
crohn_known_indication_definition: Union of ChEMBL max_phase_for_ind == 4 for MeSH D003424 and OT indication reports with APPROVAL and origin DRUG_LABEL or REGULATORY_AGENCY; used for labels/exclusions only
clinical_trial_definition: First posted on or before as_of_date; explicit Crohn condition; INTERVENTIONAL; primary purpose TREATMENT or missing; at least one DRUG/BIOLOGICAL intervention

feasibility_gates.note: Exploratory engineering gates, not a statistical power calculation; specify before computing final metrics.
